'''Aarsix''' was<ref name="TOR" /> a [[Gender/Legends|male]]<ref name="Jedipedia-NPCData" /> [[Humanoid/Legends|humanoid]] who served the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] during the [[Galactic War]] against the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith Empire]].<ref name="TOR" /> In [[3642 BBY]],<ref name="Date">{{TOR dates|2}} As the three aforementioned classes can encounter Aarsix in Act II on [[Quesh]], they must have been present on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] in 3642 [[Galactic Standard Calendar|BBY]].</ref> they were stationed in the [[Republic Operational Headquarters]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Quesh]] during the [[Quesh war|Republic–Empire conflict]] there. Aarsix worked selling heavy [[Armor/Legends|armor]] from a stall.<ref name="TOR" />

Aarsix wore [[Color/Legends|yellow]]-colored full body armor while at their stall, which was exposed to Quesh's [[Poison/Legends|toxic]] [[Atmosphere/Legends|atmosphere]], and also carried a [[Blaster rifle/Legends|blaster rifle]].<ref name="TOR" />

==Behind the scenes==
Aarsix first appeared in the [[2011]] [[Star Wars video games|massively multiplayer online role playing game]] ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]'', which was created by [[BioWare]]. In the game, they served as a heavy armor vendor on Quesh.<ref name="TOR" /> Their location is also marked on a map of Quesh in 2011 [[Prima Games]]' ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic Explorer's Guide]]'', although the guide refers to them as "Aarssix."<ref name="Guide">''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic Explorer's Guide]]''</ref>
